summary: Learn to assess AI risks, test controls and report assurance findings using NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001. Explore the course.
lede: AI governance auditing helps internal auditors, risk managers, compliance officers and governance professionals assess how AI and automation are approved, controlled and monitored. The training covers building risk registers and impact assessments, mapping decision rights and controls, and testing approval, supplier and human-review evidence. Participants practise documenting findings, reporting residual risk and tracking remediation; technical model validation is covered conceptually, not as implementation training.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review, govern or report on AI and automation initiatives in financial services, telecommunications, public services and large NGOs.
modules: Three Lines Model for AI Assurance
prerequisites: Working familiarity with internal audit, risk management, compliance or corporate governance is recommended. No coding or AI model development is required; the course addresses AI assurance at operational review and audit-planning level.
